## 维护者速读

- 控制台的裸数据页上,从右侧抽屉打开记录后,抽屉顶栏多出「整页打开」按钮;点它进记录整页,整页上点关闭回到原来带条件的数据页。
- 属于「记录详情页重做」专题,让数据页的抽屉跟对象列表的抽屉一样,两处不再不一致。
- 用数据页看记录的人会碰到;出错时最多是按钮不出现或进整页后回不到原页,改动可以整体撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The bare data page (`ObjectDataPage`, the app's object `data` route) mounts its record drawer with `NavigationOverlay`, and now hands it `onExpand`: the drawer's top bar draws the same ⤢ 「Open as full page」 button (`record-pane-open-page`) the object list's drawer draws, because it is that same control of the shared overlay, not a copy.

- **⤢ opens the record's full page with the origin a name click carries.** The name click's navigation (the record URL plus the history-state `from` built by `listOriginOf`, and the phone's pushed-page marker) moved into one callback, `openRecordPage`, which both the name click and the drawer's ⤢ call. So the two entries cannot drift: the page's top bar counts the record among the data page's rows, ↑ ↓ step through them, and ✕ returns to the data page with its conditions.
- **The drawer closes first**, as the object list's ⤢ does (`handleOpenAsPage` closes the drawer, then navigates): `listOriginOf` already strips `?recordId=` from the origin, so the ✕ lands on the data page with no drawer.
- The button is drawn only while a served record is open (`openedRecordId`); a list-only object still opens no drawer at all.

## Tests

Pinned beside the data page's open rule, as a new top-level `describe` in `ObjectDataPage.openRule-35875.test.tsx` (it is the data page's open-path harness: the real `ObjectDataPage`, `ListView` grid and `MePermissionsProvider`, and a record-route probe reading the origin through `useRecordPageReturn`):

- the drawer opened from the hover icon draws a button named 「Open as full page」 (`record-pane-open-page`); a click opens `.../record/a2` with `from` equal to the data page's URL with its condition, its name, its rows and its matched count, position 2 of the matched count, and the drawer gone;
- the full page's ✕ after ⤢ returns to the data page with `filter[status]=active`, no `recordId`, and no drawer.

## Acceptance notes

- Read first, by risk: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx` (`openRecordPage`, `openDrawerRecordAsPage`, the `NavigationOverlay` mount's `onExpand`).
- Two-minute check: open any object's data page in the Console (`/apps/APP/OBJECT/data?filter[FIELD]=VALUE`), hover a row and click the small panel icon after the name: the drawer opens with a ⤢ in its top bar; click it: the record's full page opens; click ✕: back on the data page with the condition chip and no drawer.
- The object list's drawer also offers 「Open as full page」 as the last item of the record header's ⋯ menu (`RecordPaneContext`, provided by `RecordStackDrawer`); the data page's drawer mounts `NavigationOverlay` directly and provides no pane context, so its ⋯ menu has no such item, before and after this change. The card asks for the ⤢ button only; noted, not filed. Read from code, not measured on a running page.
- The claim's file surface named a new card-named test file; the pin is a top-level `describe` in the existing open-rule harness file instead, per the repository's rule that a new pin for a component with a harness goes into that file (ruling record 6583487846), so the harness is not copied.
